solves.reasoning: provide ___ evidence=substantial(상당한), stimuli particularly ___=meaningful, register connection ___=actively(능동적 모방). substantial-meaningful-actively.
___ this connection actively=register(나타내다), gestures with some ___ then experiment until succeed=difficulty, show ___ by brightening eyes=pleasure. register-difficulty-pleasure.
an ___ human disposition=innate, experiment until they ___ (뒤 'When they do succeed')=succeed, innate ___ to do so (뒤 innate drive)=drive. innate-succeed-drive.
④ reluctance(꺼림) ≠ 원문 drive. 모방하려는 '욕구'가 있다는 글의 요지와 정반대. ①substantial ②meaningful ③variety 적절.
① passively(수동적으로) ≠ 원문 actively. 유아가 능동적으로 모방한다는 능동성이 핵심. ②difficulty ③pleasure ④imitate 적절.
③ fail ≠ 원문 succeed. 성공할 때까지 실험(뒤 'When they do succeed'). ①innate ②register ④perceived 적절.
gestures with some ___, experimenting until they succeed → 고전(苦戰) 문맥 = difficulty. ease/comfort는 모순.
when they fail, they show ___ → 성공=pleasure와 대조 = distress(고통). relief/excitement 부적절.
stimuli are particularly ___ for them → 선호적으로 향하는 이유 = meaningful. confusing/threatening이면 향하지 않음.
substantial(상당한)=considerable. doubtful/minor(반대)/artificial 무관.
disposition(성향)=tendency. appearance(외모)/obligation(의무)/reaction(반응) 부적절.
perceived(인지된)=recognized. rejected(반대)/imagined/created 무관.
innate(타고난)의 반의어=acquired(후천적으로 습득된). natural은 유의어, sudden/genuine은 다른 축.
distress(고통)의 반의어=comfort(편안함). sorrow는 유의어, distance/silence는 다른 축.
(A) innate drive to imitate=충동/욕구(명사), (B) drive my car=운전하다(동사). ③ 정확.
'ability or power to do, experience, understand'=capacity(능력). disposition/stimulus/gesture 불일치.
동사 register를 수식하는 자리 → 부사 필요. active(형용사) → actively(부사).
주절에 이어 동시 동작 분사구문. 주어 they 능동 → 현재분사. experiment → experimenting.
show pleasure by a ___ → 기쁨의 긍정적 표정 신호 = brightening of their eyes. trembling hands(두려움) 등 부적절.
orient towards face/voice, stimuli are ___ → particularly meaningful for them. useless/hidden이면 향할 이유 없음.
